title: import-values in child-parent format doesn't work

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Categorizes issue or PR as related to a bug.

body:
Hi, Can't get example from here to work:
https://helm.sh/docs/topics/charts/#using-the-child-parent-format

To reproduce:
```bash
cat >Chart.yaml <<EOF
apiVersion: v2
name: mychart
version: 0.1.0
dependencies:
- name: subchart1
  version: 0.1.0
  import-values:
  - child: default.data
    parent: myimports
EOF

cat >values.yaml <<EOF
myimports:
  myint: 0
  mybool: false
  mystring: "helm rocks!"
EOF

mkdir -p templates
cat >templates/test.yaml <<EOF
out: | {{ $.Values | toYaml | nindent 2 }}
EOF

mkdir -p charts/subchart1/
cat >charts/subchart1/Chart.yaml <<EOF
apiVersion: v2
name: subchart1
version: 0.1.0
EOF

cat >charts/subchart1/values.yaml <<EOF
default:
  data:
    myint: 999
    mybool: true
EOF

helm template .
```

Result:
```bash
---
# Source: mychart/templates/test.yaml
out: | 
  myimports:
    mybool: false
    myint: 0
    mystring: helm rocks!
  subchart1:
    default:
      data:
        mybool: true
        myint: 999
    global: {}
```

Expected:
```bash
---
# Source: mychart/templates/test.yaml
out: | 
  myimports:
    mybool: true
    myint: 999
    mystring: helm rocks!
  subchart1:
    default:
      data:
        mybool: true
        myint: 999
    global: {}
```

Output of `helm version`:
```
version.BuildInfo{Version:"v3.6.3", GitCommit:"d506314abfb5d21419df8c7e7e68012379db2354", GitTreeState:"clean", GoVersion:"go1.16.5"}
```


Strange thing is that these two differ: https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/4a0b3d8c3d9fbbf3a87a347b215ee9f9cdea6ad9/pkg/chartutil/dependencies.go#L251
https://github.com/helm/helm/blob/4a0b3d8c3d9fbbf3a87a347b215ee9f9cdea6ad9/pkg/chartutil/dependencies.go#L263
Can't quite get my head around it. The short form of import-values works differently and looks like it's fine.
